title_zh: Los Altos 与 Palo Alto 选房：AI 从业家庭的居家办公清单
title_en: Buying in Los Altos or Palo Alto: A Home-Office Checklist for AI Households
summary_zh: 除了多一间卧室，先核对双人会议的空间分隔、具体地址的网络、屏幕眩光和日常动线，让每一分购房与改造预算更有目的。
summary_en: Look beyond an extra bedroom. Check simultaneous calls, address-specific internet options, screen glare, and everyday routines before committing to a home or an improvement budget.
body_zh:
为 AI 从业家庭挑选 Los Altos、Palo Alto 或 Mountain View 的住宅时，居家办公需求不必只用“多一间房”来表达。更有用的起点，是把一个真实工作日写下来：谁在家办公，何时需要开会，家人又会怎样使用这些空间。以下是一份看房时可以随身使用的讨论清单，不代表任何具体房屋已经满足这些条件。

一、先模拟两个人同时开会
走进候选办公空间，关上门，留意它与厨房、起居室和另一处工作区的距离。一起讨论：一个人参加视频会议时，另一人是否仍有可用的位置？家人进出是否必须穿过镜头背景？这是空间使用的初步观察，不是专业隔音检测。对于重要的隔音需求，进一步请相应专业人员评估。

二、按具体地址核对网络
不要只因为房子位于某个城市，就假定它具备某种网络接入。FCC 的国家宽带地图支持按地址查看运营商申报的服务信息。它适合做初步核对，但不能替代向运营商确认当前可安装的服务、上传速度、费用和安装安排。看房时也可记录现有路由器、插座与布线路径的位置，之后再评估是否需要调整。
参考：https://help.bdc.fcc.gov/hc/en-us/articles/10467446103579-How-to-Use-the-FCC-s-National-Broadband-Map

三、把采光放回屏幕和座位的位置
照片里的明亮，不一定等于实际办公时舒服。想象桌面、显示器和镜头会放在哪里，再留意窗户、遮阳和反光。美国能源部的采光资料也将自然光与眩光、热量等因素一起讨论。对于有意向的房屋，如果条件允许，可以申请在不同时间再次参观，而不是只根据一次开放日判断。
参考：https://www.energy.gov/articles/energy-101-daylighting

四、让办公与生活都留有余地
问自己几个具体问题：家里来客人时，工作区是否会消失？不办公时，设备能否收纳？孩子或家人的活动是否与会议时间冲突？答案未必要求更大的房子，也可能是更合适的房间位置与使用安排。

五、先梳理问题，再决定改造预算
将观察分成三类：必须在选房阶段满足的条件、可以通过布置改善的事项，以及需要专业评估和报价的工程。先确认范围和费用，再决定投入。不要把还未核实的改造可能性，当成房屋已经具备的功能。

用心服务每一个家，让每一次交易、每一分投入，都创造更大的价值。如果你正在比较半岛住宅，可以把这份清单和自己的工作日安排带来，与 CiCi 一起梳理下一步的看房重点。讨论从你的生活出发，不承诺某项改造的固定回报。

body_en:
When comparing homes in Los Altos, Palo Alto, or Mountain View, an AI household’s work-from-home needs deserve a more precise brief than “one extra bedroom.” Start with an ordinary workday: who works at home, when calls overlap, and how everyone else uses the space. The checklist below is a framework for evaluating a home, not a claim that any particular property already meets these requirements.

1. Simulate two calls at once
Step into the proposed workspace, close the door, and consider its distance from the kitchen, living room, and a second work area. If one person is on a video call, does the other still have a usable place to work? Will someone have to walk through the camera background? These observations help you evaluate the layout; they are not a professional acoustic assessment. Have a qualified specialist assess important sound-isolation requirements.

2. Check internet service at the specific address
A city name alone does not establish the connection available at a particular home. The FCC National Broadband Map lets you look up providers’ reported service information by address. Use it as a starting point, then confirm current serviceability, upload speeds, pricing, and installation arrangements directly with the provider. Note existing router, outlet, and wiring locations so you can evaluate any changes later.
Reference: https://help.bdc.fcc.gov/hc/en-us/articles/10467446103579-How-to-Use-the-FCC-s-National-Broadband-Map

3. Evaluate daylight from the desk’s perspective
A bright listing photograph does not necessarily tell you how a screen will feel during the workday. Imagine the desk, monitor, and camera positions, then consider windows, shading, and reflections. The U.S. Department of Energy’s daylighting guidance discusses natural light together with glare and heat. If access permits, request another visit at a different time of day rather than relying on a single open-house impression.
Reference: https://www.energy.gov/articles/energy-101-daylighting

4. Preserve room for life beyond work
Will the workspace disappear whenever guests stay? Can equipment be put away after work? Do other household activities overlap with meeting times? The answer may be a better room arrangement rather than a larger home. Make those tradeoffs explicit before deciding what matters most.

5. Define the problem before setting an improvement budget
Sort your observations into three groups: conditions the home must already satisfy, issues that furnishings may address, and work that requires professional evaluation and estimates. Confirm scope and cost before committing. An unverified renovation possibility should not be treated as an existing property feature.

Thoughtful care for every home means giving every decision and investment a clear purpose. Bring this checklist and your workday routine to a conversation with CiCi about Peninsula homes. Together, you can identify useful questions for the next tour without assuming a fixed return from any improvement.
